components.name: Primary Action Button

components.name: Path Input Field
components.description: Recessed path input with integrated adornment controls and drop feedback.
components.css: .ds-input-container { display: flex; align-items: center; background: #0B0F18; border: 1px solid rgba(148, 163, 184, 0.16); border-radius: 8px; padding: 2px 8px; width: 100%; transition: border-color 0.15s ease; } .ds-input-container:hover { border-color: rgba(148, 163, 184, 0.32); } .ds-input-container:focus-within { border-color: #6366F1; box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px #6366F1; } .ds-input-field { flex: 1; background: transparent; border: none; outline: none; color: #F1F5F9; font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif; font-size: 0.88rem; padding: 8px 6px; } .ds-input-clear { background: transparent; border: none; color: #94A3B8; cursor: pointer; padding: 4px; display: flex; align-items: center; } .ds-input-clear:hover { color: #F1F5F9; }

components.name: Ready Status Chip
components.description: Technical monospace badge indicating ready or processing status.
components.css: .ds-chip-ready { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; font-size: 0.72rem; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.04em; color: #34D399; background: rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.12); border: 1px solid rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.30); border-radius: 6px; padding: 2px 8px; text-transform: uppercase; }

narrative.overview: SyncForge is designed as a focused, dark-mode audio/video laboratory combining industrial carbon surfaces, electric indigo action triggers, and laser-precise technical readouts. The interface balances high-throughput desktop batch utility with the aesthetic rigor of professional audio hardware and native system consoles. Visual anti-references are strictly defined: SyncForge rejects generic pastel SaaS cards, playful marketing illustrations, bubbly rounded pill buttons, and emojis anywhere in system dialogs or notifications.
keyCharacteristics: Deep carbon-slate tonal hierarchy (#090C12 root to #0F141F card surfaces) with translucent hairline boundaries.
Dual-tone typographic hierarchy: clean neutral Inter for navigation and labels, paired with prominent monospace for all technical data.
High-contrast signal accents: Electric Forge Indigo (#6366F1) for primary actions, Signal Sky (#38BDF8) for subtitles, and Audio Match Emerald (#34D399) for verified tracks.
Studio patchbay ergonomics: tactile track selection cards, integrated adornment clear buttons, and drag-and-drop batch matcher slots.

rules.name: The Action Accent Rule
rules.body: #6366F1 is reserved strictly for primary execution triggers, the active module selection rail, and active input focus rings. It is never used for purely decorative fills.

rules.name: The Stream Color Rule
rules.body: Subtitle streams and related badges must use Signal Sky (#38BDF8), while audio streams and matching confirmations must use Emerald (#34D399). Colors represent stream data types consistently across all 6 modules.

rules.name: The No Emoji Doctrine
rules.body: Emoticons and unicode emojis are strictly forbidden across all UI surfaces, modals, toasts, tooltips, and log outputs. All iconography must use Material Design glyphs.

rules.name: The Technical Monospace Rule
rules.body: Any data point generated by a media container (MKVToolNix IDs, codec names, language codes, timestamps, bitrates, file sizes, and terminal output) must render in monospace font.

rules.name: The Sentence-Case Action Rule
rules.body: Buttons and control labels use clean sentence casing without forced full uppercase text transforms.

rules.name: The Hairline Boundary Rule
rules.body: Visual separation between surfaces is achieved by a 1px border stroke (rgba(148, 163, 184, 0.12 - 0.16)) and backdrop blur (backdrop-filter: blur(12px)), never by thick borders or heavy box shadows.

rules.name: The Recessed Field Rule
rules.body: Editable input areas, track rows, and terminal logs are tonally darker than their parent containers (#0B0F18 inside #0F141F), creating an intuitive socket or patchbay affordance.

dos: Do maintain pixel-perfect vertical alignment between form inputs and action buttons (40px small input height).
Do integrate input clear buttons inside text fields as input adornments (slotProps.input.endAdornment).
Do render all MKVToolNix IDs, codec names, language codes, timestamps, and ETA counters in monospace font.
Do respect the module settings applicability matrix; never display irrelevant settings for the active module.
Do use Material Design icons (@mui/icons-material/*) for all iconography.
donts: Don't use emojis or unicode emotes anywhere in the user interface, dialogs, tooltips, or toast notifications.
Don't apply heavy ambient drop shadows to buttons or cards; use tonal contrast and hairline borders.
Don't allow action buttons to float disconnected outside their corresponding input containers.
Don't force uppercase transformation on general UI buttons or navigation text.
Don't mix track stream colors: subtitles are always Signal Sky (#38BDF8) and audio is always Emerald (#34D399).
